err.mzrun.commit: Run-log engine error. The prov/1 of the run has no 40-character commit in its agent (program built outside git without MZLAB_COMMIT); no parameter.
err.mzrun.roleNone: CLI flow record error. {file} = a file name in the roles file with no sha256, {inputs} = the file names of the run, comma separated.
err.mzrun.roleSeveral: CLI flow record error. Same as err.mzrun.roleNone, but several inputs of the run with different content have that file name.
err.mzrun.build: Run-log engine error. {what} = part of the plan or of the files that is missing or invalid, {detail} = its name (English text from the engine).
err.module.reply: Site error: a reader module (wasm-lettori) answers with bytes the engine cannot decode; it is not the fault of the file type. {detail} = part of the reply (index, scan, protocol, module, samples, open).
error.sdf.ion: Error of the MOL/SDF export of the drawing; {ion} = name of the adduct asked for, not present in the table.
error.sdf.molfile: Error of the MOL/SDF export of the drawing; {message} = technical text from the molfile reader.
error.sdf.tooBig: Error of the MOL/SDF export of the drawing; {max} = maximum number of atoms.
error.workStopped: Engine error: a worker thread (file fingerprint) stopped without a result. {detail} = which job (hash).
error.newerFormat: Error when an index (.mzidx) or a pipeline table (.mzfeat, .mzfeatf) is in a newer format than the program; {version} = format version found (the engine also adds {kind}, {file}). The file is not touched.
err.scan.level: CLI error of spectrum get: --ms-level is absent and the file has several MS levels, none of them 1; {levels} = the levels present, {hint} = the flag to give (--ms-level N).
err.scan.unknown: CLI error: no scan has the number given to --scan; {id} = that number.
err.spectrum.rebin: Usage error of spectrum get --bin and of rebin= on api/spectrum: the value is neither nominal nor 0.1; {value} = the text given.
err.spectrum.rebin.hr: spectrum get --bin or rebin= on api/spectrum asked of a high-resolution file, whose spectrum is not cut into nominal bins.
err.spectrum.compare.param: Usage error of spectrum compare --set: {name} = the parameter name given, which is neither tol nor ce_tol.
err.spectrum.compare.value: Usage error of spectrum compare --set: {name} = the parameter whose value is not a number of zero or more.
err.spectrum.compare.input: Error of spectrum compare, from the shared function: {side} = a or b, {what} = the member that is missing or not binned.
err.spectrum.compare.empty: Error of spectrum compare: {side} = a or b, the selection gave only empty bins.
err.spectrum.compare.precursor: Selector error of spectrum compare: --a-precursor or --b-precursor ({given}) does not match the precursor of the scan given by number ({found}).
err.spectrum.compare.precursors: Selector error of spectrum compare: {precursors} = the distinct precursors (m/z) of the scans in the window, separated by commas.
err.scan.maxRequest: API error; {n} = maximum number of scans per request.
err.scan.outsideN: API error; {n} = number of scans in the file.
err.scan.maxAverage: API error; {n} = maximum number of scans for an average.
err.pda.scale: DAD subtraction error; {scale} = the scale text given (none, max, tic, fit or a number).
err.dad.msNoLevel: DAD ms-at error; {level} = the MS level asked for (--level).
err.dad.msRange: DAD ms-at error; {level} = MS level, {rt} = the MS time asked (UV time plus offset, minutes), {start} and {end} = first and last scan time of that level (minutes).
err.dad.msEmpty: DAD ms-at error; {level} = MS level, {scan_rt} = the time of the nearest scan (minutes).
err.dad.delayNoPeaks: DAD delay error; {delay} = the estimated delay in minutes, {corr} = its correlation (0 to 1).
err.pda.view: DAD subtraction error; {view} = the view text given (map, spectrum or trace).
err.pda.window: DAD command error; {need} = the missing option (--rt or --nm).
err.subxic.many: Formula XIC error; {n} = number of subformulas of the formula typed.
err.subxic.none: Formula XIC error; {mz} = minimum m/z chosen.
error.memoryBudgetFase: Engine memory error with phase, estimate and budget. {fase} = rejected phase, {stima_mb} = estimated memory in MB, {budget_mb} = budget in MB, {eccesso_mb} = MB missing.
error.memoryBudgetFase.indexPeaks: The .mzidx index is rejected because a 1 Da m/z interval is too dense. {stima_mb} = MB of peaks (at least) in that interval, {budget_mb} = maximum MB for one interval (twice the builder's budget).
error.memoryBudgetFase.detect: Detection (features.detect) rejected before starting because the estimate from the index header exceeds the budget. {stima_mb} = estimated MB, {budget_mb} = engine budget in MB.
err.xic.sweep.mz: CLI usage error of trace xic: both --mz and --sweep, or neither, were given.
err.xic.sweep.spec: CLI usage error of trace xic: --sweep is not LO:HI:STEP with numbers, STEP above 0 and LO below HI.
err.xic.sweep.size: CLI usage error of trace xic: the sweep has more centres than one call takes. {n} = the number of centres.
err.xic.sweep.tol: Usage error of api/xic?sweep=: the tol (half-window in Da) is not a number above 0.
error.memoryBudgetFase.xicSweep: XIC sweep (trace xic --sweep, api/xic?sweep=) rejected before starting: centres x scans x 8 bytes exceeds half the engine budget. {stima_mb} = estimated MB, {budget_mb} = engine budget in MB.
error.memoryBudgetFase.read: Step that reads a whole mzML (spectra.ms2, formula.ms1) rejected before starting because the estimate from the file's tags (points, spectra, MGF text) exceeds the budget. {stima_mb} = estimated MB, {budget_mb} = engine budget in MB.
error.memoryBudgetFase.msnGraph: MSn graph rejected while reading the spectra of a consensus because the estimate (extrapolated from the spectra already read) exceeds the engine budget. {stima_mb} = estimated MB of the spectra, {budget_mb} = budget in MB.
error.memoryBudgetFase.readTable: Flow step in the browser that reads the whole .mzfeat file (feature table: table.filter, export.table_csv, export.mztab, tp.link, tp.dig_lr, tp.filter/position/network/review, table.stats/drift, features.group) rejected before reading it because the file size (worker copy and .wasm copy, plus 16 MB base) exceeds the budget. {stima_mb} = estimated MB, {budget_mb} = engine budget in MB.
error.memoryBudgetFase.mzmlInMemory: Conversion of a vendor file to mzML (loading, «Download .mzML», centroid copy) in a browser without OPFS: the mzML stays in memory in pieces and the conversion stops when it exceeds the engine budget. {stima_mb} = MB already reached, {budget_mb} = engine budget in MB.
warn.spectrum.ceDiffer: Warning of spectrum compare, on stderr and in the document: {a} and {b} = the collision energy of each spectrum in eV.
warn.spectrum.ceMixed: Warning of spectrum compare: {side} = a or b, {ce_values} = the collision energies found, separated by slashes.
warn.spectrum.ceUnknown: Warning of spectrum compare: {side} = a or b.
warn.spectrum.precursorDiffer: Warning of spectrum compare: {a} and {b} = the precursor m/z of each spectrum.
warn.wiff.unindexed: Calm warning, one per file (site, CLI and app): the .wiff.scan of a SCIEX pair contains data sections that the .wiff index does not list (copy made during acquisition). {n} = sections found, {recovered} = recovered as samples (name and method inferred, the name is <file>_s<N>), {skipped} = left out because they cannot be verified.
warn.wiff.emptySample: Reason shown for a .wiff sample with no scans or chromatograms (sample row, CLI progress line): calm, one line.
warn.wiff.inferredSample: Reason shown for a sample rebuilt from a section that the .wiff index does not list (next to the file note warn.wiff.unindexed).
warn.wiff.damaged: Calm partial-read warning (conversion/1.loss, CLI): blocks of the .wiff.scan that do not match the index, left out and counted.
warn.wiff.short.writing: CLI warning of sample list (stderr): the .wiff.scan ends before the .wiff index does and the pair was modified within the limit, so it may still be written (exit 8). {file}, {scan_bytes}, {indexed_end}, {wiff_bytes} = sizes in bytes, {age_s} = seconds since the newest member changed, {recent_s} = the limit (10).
warn.wiff.short.idle: CLI warning of sample list (stderr): the .wiff.scan ends before the .wiff index does and the pair has not changed within the limit: a finished partial copy (exit 1). Same parameters as warn.wiff.short.writing.
warn.wiff.short.unknown: CLI warning of sample list (stderr): the .wiff.scan ends before the .wiff index does and the file times are not known (exit 1). {file}, {scan_bytes}, {indexed_end}, {wiff_bytes} as in warn.wiff.short.writing.
warn.wiff.unlisted.writing: CLI warning of sample list (stderr): the .wiff.scan holds sections after the index and the pair was modified within the limit, so it may still be written (exit 8). {listed} = samples the index lists, {unlisted} = sections found after it, plus the parameters of warn.wiff.short.writing.
warn.wiff.unlisted.idle: CLI warning of sample list (stderr): the .wiff.scan holds sections after the index and the pair has not changed within the limit: a finished partial copy (exit 1). Same parameters as warn.wiff.unlisted.writing.
warn.wiff.unlisted.unknown: CLI warning of sample list (stderr): the .wiff.scan holds sections after the index and the file times are not known (exit 1). {file}, {listed}, {unlisted}, {wiff_bytes} as in warn.wiff.unlisted.writing.
warn.scan.levelOnly: CLI note of spectrum get (stderr): --ms-level was absent and the file has scans at one MS level other than 1, which was used. {name} = the file, {level} = that level.
warn.waters.damaged: Calm partial-read warning (conversion/1.loss, CLI) for a Waters folder: damaged scans or functions left out and counted; the rest is read.
error.memoryBudget.native: Like error.memoryBudget, but in the desktop app and the CLI: the limit is the memory chosen for the computer, not the browser's.
error.memoryBudgetFase.native: Like error.memoryBudgetFase, but in the desktop app and the CLI. Same placeholders: {fase}, {stima_mb}, {budget_mb}, {libero_mb}, {eccesso_mb}.
error.memoryBudgetFase.indexPeaks.native: Like error.memoryBudgetFase.indexPeaks, but in the desktop app and the CLI. {stima_mb} = MB of peaks in the 1 Da interval, {budget_mb} = maximum MB for one interval.
error.memoryBudgetFase.detect.native: Like error.memoryBudgetFase.detect, but in the desktop app and the CLI: the limit is the memory chosen for the computer. {stima_mb} = estimated MB, {budget_mb} = budget in MB.
error.memoryBudgetFase.read.native: Like error.memoryBudgetFase.read, but in the desktop app and the CLI: the limit is the memory chosen for the computer and the estimate counts all the files of the step, held in memory together. {stima_mb} = estimated MB, {budget_mb} = budget in MB.
error.memoryBudgetFase.msnGraph.native: Like error.memoryBudgetFase.msnGraph, but in the desktop app and the CLI (`msn graph --budget-mb`). {stima_mb} = estimated MB of the spectra, {budget_mb} = engine budget in MB.
error.memoryBudgetFase.openFiles: Opening the index of one more file is refused: even after the cache is emptied, the browser gives no memory beside the files already open in the engine. {aperti} = files open, {scansioni} = their scans.
error.memoryBudgetFase.openFiles.native: Like error.memoryBudgetFase.openFiles, but in the desktop app. {aperti} = files open, {scansioni} = their scans.
error.memoryBudgetFase.whole: A vendor format that is read whole (.wiff, .lcd/.qgd, Agilent .d, Waters .raw, Bruker) exceeds the fixed limit of the site (192 MB). {stima_mb} = MB to hold, {budget_mb} = limit in MB.
error.memoryBudgetFase.whole.native: Like error.memoryBudgetFase.whole, but in the desktop app (limit 1024 MB). {stima_mb} = MB to hold, {budget_mb} = limit in MB.
error.poolLowered: One-time note: the indexing pool reduces its workers because of insufficient memory. {from} = workers before, {to} = workers after.
err.stat.pca.few: Error: too few samples for the PCA. {min} = minimum, {n} = samples available.
error.quota: Error when loading a large file: the browser's space is not enough. {serve_mb} = MB needed (file + index), {libero_mb} = MB free.
error.quotaWrite: Error when the browser rejects a write although it reports free space (full disk, private window). {scritti_mb} = MB already written when it stopped, {serve_mb} = MB of the whole file, {libero_mb} = MB the browser reports as free.
error.msngrafo.badFile: Error for a saved graph file that cannot be read; {file} = file name, {raw} = technical reason.
error.msngrafo.tooBig: A saved graph (g.json) larger than the page's cap is not opened; {file} = file name, {mb} = its size in MB, {max} = cap in MB.
meta.notDecoded: Entry of method/1.warnings (Method window, note of the CLI convert): a part of the file that the reader does not decode. {place} = the part, English text from the reader.
meta.truncated: Entry of method/1.warnings: the file ends before its declared end. {place} = where, text from the reader.
err.transitions.table: Engine error message; {row} = row, key and text of the first error in the table.
err.request.badValue: Engine error message; {name} = name of the request parameter.
error.sub.column: Engine error message (Flow step structure.moiety); {column} = name of the column searched for.
error.sub.db: Engine error message (substructure search in a list of structures).
error.sub.dbSize: Engine error message (substructure search); {n} = entries in the list, {max} = maximum.
error.sub.query: Engine error message (substructure search); {detail} = technical reason in English.
error.posiz.formula: Engine error message; {a} = first product, {b} = second product.
error.qc.tooFew: Engine error message; {have} = how many there are.
err.msnlib.badIon: CLI error of msn lib build; {ion} = the neutral formula and adduct of a manifest row that the graph cannot use.
err.noise.noBackground: Data error of peak noise (mzlab-cli) and noise_floor (engine): no finite background point is left, because every finite point of the trace stretch is inside the peak window, the stretch from/to is empty or reversed (from > to), or every intensity in it is not a number.
err.normative.usage: CLI error of normative; {message} = what is wrong with the command line.
err.normative.sources: CLI error of normative; {message} = what is wrong with sources.json.
err.normative.pin: CLI error of normative; {message} = the sources whose SHA-256 changed.
err.normative.large: CLI error of normative; {message} = the download and its limit.
err.normative.fetch: CLI error of normative; {message} = the source and the reason.
err.normative.parse: CLI error of normative; {message} = the list and the reason.
err.normative.io: CLI error of normative; {message} = the file that cannot be written and the reason.
err.normative.input: CLI error of normative; {message} = the file that cannot be read and the reason.
err.reflist.adduct: Row error of a CSV list: the adduct column holds a name the program does not know; {value} = the text read.
err.reflist.formula: Row error of a CSV list: the formula column cannot be read; {value} = the text read.
err.reflist.mz: Row error of a CSV list: the m/z column is not a number above 0; {value} = the text read.
err.reflist.polarity: Row error of a CSV list: the polarity column holds an unknown word; {value} = the text read.
err.quant.targets.table: quant targets error; {row} = where the row is: its line in the CSV file (1 = the first line, the header) or its 1-based item in a JSON list (0 = the whole table), {detail} = the field and why it is refused.
note.quant.targets.offsetAuto: quant targets hint (stderr of the CLI and the hints of --json); {id} = the standard or parent row, {count} = files where it was not detected, {files} = files counted (blanks left out).
note.quant.targets.rtRef: quant targets hint (stderr of the CLI and the hints of --json); {id} = the standard or parent row, {min} {max} = the lowest and highest apex RT of it in minutes, {spread} = their difference.
err.quant.targets.param: quant targets parameter error; {name} = the parameter (da, min_sn, min_points, min_shape, min_half, max_fwhm, max_asym, offset...), {value} = the text given; the shape gates min_half, max_fwhm and max_asym accept 0 (off) or a count/limit in range, and max_asym is 0 or at least 1.
warn.quant.targets.forced: Hint of quant targets (CLI stderr, warnings of --json and of the flow log, site): at least one row has a peak that missed a check (S/N, points, shape or a shape gate), so its state is forced, not detected; the numbers are kept. It names the parameters that decide what counts as detected (min_sn, min_half, max_fwhm, max_asym) and the log key (decisions) that lists the evidence. No placeholders.
err.union.request: Error of quant union and of the union route: the request is not a JSON object with a list of tables.
err.union.empty: Error of quant union: no table was given or none has a row.
err.union.table: Error of quant union: a series table cannot be used; {table} = its name, {row} = its line in the CSV (1 = the header), {detail} = the field and the reason (bad_mz, bad_rt, bad_polarity, no_column_mz, no_column_rt, empty).
err.union.param: Error of quant union: a parameter value out of range or a parameter that does not exist; {name} = the parameter (da, rt_tol, rt_warp, rt_gap, min_series, pad, polarity), {value} = the text given.
err.raw.probe: Usage error of raw info (--probe) and of probe= on api/rawinfo: not a whole number from 1 to {max}. {max} = the largest number of probe scans.
err.raw.scan.channel: Usage error of raw scan and of api/rawscan: the channel asked is not a scan channel (a chromatogram, UV or SRM trace); {id} = the channel id.
err.raw.scan.param: Usage error of raw scan and of api/rawscan: a parameter value out of range or missing; {name} = the parameter (rt, bin, mz_range, top, ms_level, min_z, min_net, alpha, side_min, gap_min), {value} = the value given.
err.raw.xic.many: Usage error of raw xic and of api/rawxic: more masses than one question holds; {count} = the masses given, {max} = the most allowed.
err.raw.xic.rows: Data error (exit 1) of raw xic for one file: the rows the engine returned do not match the masses asked or cannot be read; {file} = the file, {detail} = what differs.
err.raw.xic.param: Usage error of raw xic and of api/rawxic: a parameter value out of range or missing; {name} = the parameter (mz, rt, da, ms_level, min_sn, min_points, alpha, side_min, gap_min), {value} = the text given.
warn.raw.labelMismatch: raw info warning: the spectrum type the file declares is not what the probed data show. {file} = the file name, {label} = the declared type (profile, centroid, mixed), {data} = the type the data show, {runs_share} = the share of points in continuous runs (0-1).
warn.raw.noQuantum: raw info warning: the probed intensities have no ion quantum (an analog detector or processed data), so ions cannot be counted. {file} = the file name.
err.spec.peak: Usage error of spectrum get --peak auto --set and of api/specpeak: a parameter value out of range or not a number; {name} = the parameter (factor, side_min, gap_min, min_sn, min_points), {value} = the text given.
warn.raw.oneSide: raw scan warning: the window has scans on one side only; {file} = the file, {side} = the side that has scans (left, right, or none for neither).
err.spec.fill: Usage error of spectrum get --sum --fill-ms and of api/specsum: the fill time is not a positive number (no placeholder: the route does not carry the value).
note.spec.sum.noFill: spectrum get --sum note (stderr and the evidence): the file has no fill time per scan, so ions is null and counts are cps summed over scans; no placeholders.
note.spec.sum.noQuantum: spectrum get --sum note: the probed intensities have no ion quantum, so ions_by_quantum is null; no placeholders.
note.spec.mean.sumHint: spectrum get hint (stderr) in the mean mode of a window: --sum is the way to add the scans and see their number and ions; no placeholders.
